text_block_list.name: Floe
text_block_list.text: Watch out for that fist! If your love is destroyed, you won't be able to fight properly!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの拳に警戒して！
愛を破壊されちゃうと、
まともに戦えなくなるわよ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: It's okay! We've got the Wall of Love here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫！
こっちには愛の壁があるわ！

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: The Wall of Love, is it...?

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's the 'Holy Night's Barrier – Lover Force'! Let's bounce those fists back with the Wall of Love!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
『聖夜のバリア 
─ラヴァーフォース─』です！
愛の壁で
拳なんか弾いちゃいましょう！

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: Do Christmas demons have such a power...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
クリスマスの悪魔に、
そのような力が……？
